leadText:
The Team Rocket Academy (Japanese: ロケット団特別訓練所 Team Rocket Special Training Center) is an -exclusive location likely in Kanto. It was featured in Training Daze. The academy is the place where people train to become members of Team Rocket. They undergo training and develop skills such as stealthy stealing, tracking and capturing Pokémon. The campus is a large building containing training rooms, shower rooms, bedrooms, and a nursery. The head of the Team Rocket Academy is , while the Drill Sergeant is Viper.

The Team Rocket Academy is where Jessie, James and were grouped together and became official members of Team Rocket and partners, while their rivals, Butch, Cassidy, and were also grouped together and became official members of Team Rocket.
 
The Team Rocket Academy was mentioned in passing in Sandshrew's Locker! when Mira told she wanted to join.

In A Lean Mean Team Rocket Machine!, James used his training at Team Rocket Academy, prior to being partnered with Jessie, as motivation to work as hard as possible.

In a flashback in Noodles! Roamin' Off!, was training for Team Rocket, with little success. Jessie and James bought him a bowl of ramen noodles at a noodle bar to cheer him up, and that motivated him to leave Team Rocket and start a noodle restaurant.
